headlines.title: AppLovin (APP) Flags CTV Ad Transparency Gaps As It Unveils New Data Platform
headlines.summary: Wurl, a subsidiary of AppLovin (NasdaqGS:APP), released a new CTV Trends Report highlighting transparency issues in streaming TV advertising. The report points to major data gaps in connected TV campaigns, affecting how brands measure performance and target audiences. Wurl introduced a Content Intelligence Platform intended to give advertisers clearer insight into CTV content and ad placement quality.

headlines.title: Is AppLovin (APP) Undervalued Ahead Of Third Quarter Earnings?
headlines.summary: AppLovin (APP) heads into its 4 November third quarter earnings call with investor attention locked on its AI driven ad engine, fresh e commerce push, and already high profitability. Recent swings in AppLovin’s share price tell a mixed story. The stock trades at US$262.82 after declining 15.4% over the past 30 days and 57.5% year to date on a share price basis.

headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysRBC Capital cut its AppLovin price target to $500 from $575 on Oct. 28 and kept its Outperform rating.

headlines.title: Can AppLovin's 84% EBITDA Margin Sustain APP Stock's Growth?
headlines.summary: AppLovin's AI-powered advertising platform lifts its adjusted EBITDA margin to 84%, but rising competition and costs could test its profitability.

description: AppLovin Corporation provides end-to-end artificial intelligence-powered advertising solutions for businesses in the United States and internationally. It operates through two segments, Advertising and Apps. The company offers Axon Ads Manager, a suite of marketing solutions that enables developers to automate, optimize, and manage marketing efforts; MAX, an in-app bidding technology that optimizes the value of a publisher's advertising inventory by running a real-time competitive auction; Adjust, a measurement and analytics marketing platform; and Wurl, a connected TV platform, which distributes streaming video for content companies, provides advertising and publishing solutions. It serves individuals, small and independent businesses, enterprises, advertisers and advertising networks, mobile app publishers, and indie studio developers. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, California.
